question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 and 26 hours, and an outlet C can empty it in 26 hours. If all three are opened together, in how many hours is the tank filled?
explanation:
Per hour: A fills 1/15, B fills 1/26, C empties 1/26.
Net = 1/15 + 1/26 − 1/26 = 1/15 of the tank per hour.
So the tank fills in 15 hours.
